69
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the March 7, 2006/Phalguna 16, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Heavy Industries and
Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture;
Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Report on improvement of banking
system
*221. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any study report for improving the
Nationalised banking system in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and indicating
the salient features thereof;
(c) whether this report has suggested
any measures for reducing interest rates of
Nationalised banks; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government’s reaction thereto?
Loans to small workers
†*222. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether he has asked all the banks
to provide loans to ten small workers every
year at nominal rate of interest;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to ensure that such loans are provided by
the banks;
(c) whether Government would
introduce credit card scheme for small
workers and poor people living in rural
areas also; and
(d) if so, by when and the details
thereof?
Lending to SSI sector
*223. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that priority
sector lending is a profitable business for
the banks in terms of returns on the credit
and interest subsidies to the Banks;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
the credit to the priority SSI sector has not
risen with the same rate as that of the net
bank credit of the Nationalised Banks
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

70
despite this sector offering good business
opportunity; and
(c) what steps are being taken to
encourage the banks to lend to the SSI sector
at a commensurate annual rate of growth in
NBC?
Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for
Small Industries scheme
*224. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of banks which have so
far joined the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust
for Small Industries (CGTSI) scheme;
(b) whether the private and foreign
banks can also join the scheme;
(c) if so, the number of private and
foreign banks who have so far joined the
CGTSI scheme; and
(d) what steps are being taken to
encourage banks particularly the Non-
Nationalised banks to join the scheme?
Shortage of trolleys at IGI Airport,
Delhi
*225. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that luggage
trolleys at Indira Gandhi International
Airport, Delhi  are in a bad and dilapidated
state;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the IGI
Airport is one of the major Airports in the
country and receives number of foreigners/
visitors and the state of luggage trolleys
reflects the country’s image/dignity when
a foreigner lands at Airport itself; and
(c) if so, whether Government have
taken any measures to provide trolleys in
good condition at IGI Airport?
Coordination with States to join VAT
regime
*226. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that six more
States have expressed their willingness to
switch over to the Value Added Tax (VAT)
regime in the next few months;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the time-frame finalized, if any, therefor;
(c) the States which have not yet
decided to implement the VAT regime; and
(d) the steps being taken to co-ordinate
with those States to join the VAT?
Co-operation with Saudi Arabia in
energy sector
*227. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
visit of the Saudi Arabia King to India they
have shown interest in investing in India’s
energy sector and also welcomed India’s
investment in gas fields in Saudi Arabia;
and
(b) if so, the response of Government
as the country is facing severe crisis in the
energy sector?
Demand for more supply of gas from
ONGC and GAIL
*228. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a well-known Dairy at
Mehsana are repeatedly demanding

71
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
for more supply of gas from ONGC and
GAIL;
(b) whether they have made
representation to the Petroleum Ministry;
(c) if so, reasons for ONGC and GAIL
not heeding their request for supply of gas
which is being produced in the same district,
Mehsana of Gujarat; and
(d) in the recent meeting with Petroleum
Ministry whether and what solution was
reached between the parties?
Shortage of commanders in Alliance
Air

Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the shortage of commanders
and co-pilots in Alliance Air a

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the March 7, 2006/Phalguna 16, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Heavy Industries and
Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture;
Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
Air service agreement with Thailand
1471. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have agreed
with  Thailand Government for to and fro
international flights;
(b) if so, the details of the agreement
and the extent to which India shall be
beneficiary;
(c) the number of daily flights to and
fro;
(d) the details of airports in Uttar
Pradesh from where such flights shall
operate; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Purchase of aircraft by Air India
1472. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI R. P. GOENKA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is  a fact that Air India
has entered into an agreement with the
Boeing Commercial Airplanes for purchase
of 68 aircraft at an estimated cost of
Rs. 35,000 crores;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the type(s) and distinctive features of the
new aircraft, phased programme drawn up
for their delivery and arrangements settled,
if any, for maintenance, repair and
overhauling of the large number of new
category of aircraft; and
(c) to what extent the new airplanes are
expected to help achieve operational cost
savings and expand the route network to
combat the increasing competition?
Pilots in Alliance Air
1473. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of pilots and other trained staff like
engineers have left the Alliance Air which
has adversely affected the services of the
company;

335
(b) if so, the number of persons who
resigned from Alliance Air during the last
two years;
(c) what is the existing strength of pilots
in the Alliance Air  and how many of them
are in position at present; and
(d) the steps taken to retain the
experienced persons in the Alliance Air  and
with what result?
Infrastructural development at
Chennai airport
1474. SHRI R. SHUNMUGA-
SUNDARAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Chennai has
recorded a higher growth rate in passenger
traffic and aircraft movement according to
the report of the Airports Authority of India
(AAI);
(b) whether the AAI has demanded for
the infrastructural development in the
Chennai airport terminals; and
(c) what development projects are
proposed for other airports in Tamil Nadu?
Training of CAT-III operation
†1475. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of domestic airlines
whose pilots have been imparted training
to operate the flights by using CAT-III B
landing support system in thick fog;
(b) the airports where CAT-III B
system has been installed/propose to be
installed; and
(c) the amount likely to be spent
thereon?
Committee on infrastructure for
airports
†1476. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that there is a
scheme of opening new airports and
extension of some airports in the country
by Government;
(b) if so, the details regarding opening
of new airports, State-wise;
(c) the details of the airports which are
going to be extended;
(d) by when the said scheme is likely to
be implemented; and
(e) the points identified for
consideration by 'Committee on
Infrastructure' constituted under the
Chairmanship of the Prime Minister in this
regard?
Loss making airports
1477. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Airports
Authority of India has been facing huge
loss from around 110 airports in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken for making these airports profitable
in the near future;
(d) whether Government have made any
plan for loss making airports in the country;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

336
Committee on modernisation of
airports
1478. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether an Alternate Plan Review
Committee was constituted by Chairman,
Airports Authority of India (AAI) to
examine the modernisation proposal of
Mumbai and Delhi airports prepared by
AAI Employees Joint Forum;
(b) if so, the brief outline of the
recommedations of the report;
(c) the date of submission of the report;
(d) whether any action has been taken
on the basis of the report for modernisation
of Delhi and Mumbai airports and 35 other
non-metro airports by AAI; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
FDI in greenfield airports

SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the
